app.name: AI Hypnotherapist
app.footer: This service does not provide emergency or medical care. If you are in danger, contact emergency services.
app.credits: Voice generated with Pocket TTS by Kyutai (CC BY 4.0).
app.new_consultation: Start a new consultation (this session stays available through your private link)
welcome.title: A personal hypnotherapy consultation
welcome.intro: This consultation helps us understand what you'd like help with, so your hypnotherapy session can be made personal to you.
welcome.ai_disclosure: Your consultation is carried out by an AI assistant working on behalf of a qualified hypnotherapy practice. Our qualified hypnotherapist oversees the service.
welcome.prepare: Before you begin: make sure your device is fully charged or plugged in, wear earphones for the best sound quality, and find a quiet place where you won't be disturbed.
welcome.honesty: Please answer every question carefully and honestly. Your session is built only from what you tell us, so made-up or untrue answers will stop it from helping you.
welcome.voice_disclosure: The voice you will hear is generated by AI from a real person's recorded voice, used with their consent.
welcome.price_ai: AI session: £{total} in total. That is £{consultation} for your personal consultation, paid before it starts, and £{session} for your full personalised session, only if you choose it after hearing a free 5-minute preview.
welcome.step2: You pay £{consultation} and have your private consultation by voice (about 20 minutes).
welcome.step3: You listen to a free 5-minute preview of the session made for you.
welcome.step4: You choose: your full AI session for £{session}, or a session with our qualified hypnotherapist (£{from}–£{to}).
screening.title: Before we begin
screening.intro: Please answer honestly. These questions keep you safe: some health conditions need a doctor's input before hypnotherapy.
screening.incomplete: Please answer every question and confirm both consent statements to continue.
outcome.crisis.title: Please reach out for support now
outcome.crisis.body: Thank you for telling us. We can't offer hypnotherapy through this service right now, but you don't have to go through this alone. These services are free, confidential and ready to listen:
outcome.decline_refer.title: This service isn't the right fit right now
outcome.decline_refer.body: Thank you for your answers. Based on what you've told us, hypnotherapy through this service isn't suitable at the moment. This isn't a judgement: some health conditions need a doctor's input first. Please speak to your GP or doctor about the support that's right for you.
outcome.ineligible.title: We can't continue
outcome.ineligible.body: This service is only available to adults aged 18 and over who consent to both statements. If you've changed your mind about consent, you're welcome to start again.
outcome.not_now.title: Please come back another time
outcome.not_now.body: It isn't safe to take part in hypnotherapy while under the influence of alcohol or drugs. You're very welcome to start again when you're ready.
outcome.human_only.title: Our qualified hypnotherapist can help
outcome.human_only.body: Based on your answers, a self-guided AI session isn't the right fit, but our qualified hypnotherapist may be able to help. You can request a consultation below.
consult.title: Your consultation
consult.error.ai_unavailable: Sorry, we couldn't reach the consultation service. Your message wasn't lost; please try sending it again.
consult.error.safety_unavailable: Sorry, our safety check is temporarily unavailable, so we can't continue just now. Your message wasn't lost; please try again in a moment.
consult.error.usage_limit: The test engine has reached your Claude subscription's usage limit for now, so it can't answer. The limit resets after a few hours. Your answer wasn't lost, so please try again later.
consult.error.busy: Please wait for the reply to your previous message.
consult.error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
stopped.concern.title: Let's get you the right support
stopped.concern.body: Thank you for sharing that. Based on what you've told us, a self-guided AI session isn't the right fit, and it's important that a qualified practitioner looks at your situation personally. You can request a consultation with our qualified hypnotherapist below, who may also suggest speaking with your GP first.
extracting.title: Preparing your summary…
extracting.body: We are now preparing your summary and your free 5-minute session preview. This takes a few minutes. You don't need to wait on this page: we'll email you a link as soon as it's ready.
extraction_failed.title: We couldn't prepare your summary
extraction_failed.body: Your consultation is saved. Please try again.
choice.title: Your preview, and how to continue
choice.severity: Right now, how much does this affect you? (0 = not at all, 10 = extremely)
choice.ai.title: Your full AI session
choice.ai.body: Your complete personalised session with the AI Hypnotherapist (60–85 minutes), continuing from the preview, as an MP3 to download and keep on your device.
choice.human.title: Session with our qualified hypnotherapist
choice.human.body: Work directly with our qualified hypnotherapist, online.
choice.not_suitable: Thank you for sharing so openly. From what you've told us, a session with our qualified hypnotherapist is the right next step for you, rather than a self-guided recording: they can work with you directly and adapt to you as you go.
referral.doctor.title: Please speak to your doctor first
referral.doctor.body: Thank you for being open with us. From what came up in your consultation, hypnotherapy isn't right for you at the moment without a doctor's advice. This isn't a judgement: some health conditions need a doctor's input first. Please speak to your GP or doctor about the support that's right for you. If you ever feel unsafe, contact your local emergency services straight away.
referral.no_refund: Before paying, you confirmed that your answers to the safety questions were true. As this only came up during your consultation, which has taken place, your £{amount} consultation fee is not refunded.
incomplete.title: Your consultation has ended
incomplete.body: We didn't receive enough of your answers to write a session that would truly help you, so no session has been written. You can continue your consultation for {minutes} more minutes, or have a session with our qualified hypnotherapist.
incomplete.body_final: We didn't receive enough of your answers to write a session that would truly help you, so no session has been written. A session with our qualified hypnotherapist is the best next step.
incomplete.ended_body: You stopped your consultation, so no session or preview has been made. If you would still like help, our qualified hypnotherapist can work with you.
incomplete.human: Ask for a session with our hypnotherapist
pay.consultation.title: Pay for your consultation
pay.consultation.body: After your consultation you'll hear a free 5-minute preview of the session made for you. Only then do you decide: your full AI session for £{session} more, or a session with our qualified hypnotherapist. Please answer the safety questions truthfully: if something comes up in your consultation that you said did not apply to you, no preview is made and your £{consultation} is not refunded.
pay.session.title: Pay for your full session
pay.session.body: Your complete session (60–85 minutes) is written and made for you as soon as you've paid. It takes a few minutes, and we'll email you the download link as soon as it's ready.
pay.save_card: Save my card for a quicker payment if I continue to the full session
pay.saved_card: Your saved card will be used.
pay.secure_notice: You pay on Stripe's secure payment page: we never see your card details.
pay.stripe_test_notice: Test mode: no money is taken. On Stripe's page, use the test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 with any future date and any 3 digits.
pay.redirecting: Taking you to the secure payment page…
pay.not_completed: Your payment wasn't completed, so nothing was taken. You can try again.
pay.unavailable: Payments aren't available just now. Please try again in a moment.
pay.test_notice: Test version: no card details are asked for and no money is taken. In the finished app, this is Stripe's secure payment page.
pay.email_note: We'll email your receipt and a private link, so you can come back to your session at any time, on any device.
pay.emails_ok: Also email me a reminder about my preview, and a short check-in after my session (you can stop these at any time)
pay.email_invalid: Please enter a valid email address.
pay.agree_needed: Please tick the box to confirm, so we can start straight away.
pay.receipt_to: Your receipt will be emailed to {email}.
pay.price_changed: The price has just been updated. Please reload the page to see it before you pay.
followup.title: How are you doing?
followup.intro: Thank you for coming back. It takes less than a minute.
followup.severity: Right now, how much does the issue affect you? (0 = not at all, 10 = extremely)
followup.comments: Anything you'd like to tell us? (optional)
followup.thanks: Thank you. Your answer helps us make every session better.
stop_emails.title: Stop reminder emails
stop_emails.body: You'll no longer get reminders about your preview or the check-in after your session. Receipts and the email telling you your session is ready are still sent.
stop_emails.done: Done. You won't get these emails any more.
human.title: Request a session with our qualified hypnotherapist
human.name: Full name
human.description: A short description of what you'd like help with
human.shares_consultation: Your consultation's questions and answers are sent to the hypnotherapist with your request, so you don't have to start again.
human.invalid: Please fill in your full name, a valid email address, your mobile number and a short description.
human.done.title: Thank you
human.done.body: Your request has been sent. Our qualified hypnotherapist will contact you.
generating.title: Preparing your personalised session…
generating.body: Your session is being written just for you. This takes about 3 minutes.
review.title: Your session is being reviewed
review.body: Our qualified hypnotherapist is reviewing your personalised session before it's delivered. Keep this page bookmarked: your session will appear here once it's ready.
rejected.title: Our hypnotherapist would like to work with you directly
rejected.body: After reviewing your consultation, our hypnotherapist recommends working together in a session rather than a self-guided one. You can request that below.
engine.test_notice: Test engine: running on your own Claude subscription on this computer. For your own testing only: use made-up details, never a real client's information. The test engine is slower than the final one: replies take several seconds.
stage.timer_waiting: Your {total} minutes start with your first answer
stage.end_confirm:
Are you sure you want to stop?

Your consultation will end for good: no session or preview will be made, and your £{amount} consultation fee is not refunded.
stage.paused_silence: Your consultation is paused, so none of your time is used. Press Continue whenever you're ready, and we'll carry on from where we were.
stage.practice_voice: the practice voice (AI-generated from a consenting speaker's recording)
stage.status.listening: Listening. Take your time, and pause when you've finished
stage.status.paused: Microphone paused. Press Talk to answer aloud, or type instead
stage.mic_blocked: The microphone is blocked. To answer aloud, allow microphone access for this page in your browser's address bar. You can also type your answers.
stage.mic_blocked_app: This app hasn't been given the microphone. To answer aloud, allow the microphone for this app in your phone's Settings and open it again, or open this page in your phone's browser instead. You can also type your answers.
stage.mic_error: The microphone stopped working. Press Talk to try again, or type your answer.
stage.mic_unavailable: This browser can't use the microphone here, so please type your answers. For spoken answers, open this page from its secure (https) address in an up-to-date browser.
player.title: Listen to your session
generation_failed.title: Your session needs another moment
generation_failed.body: We couldn't finish writing your session this time. Your consultation is saved, so nothing is lost: press the button to write it again.
ready.title: Your personalised session
ready.test_note: Your session is read by your device's own voice.
ready.practice_voice_note: Your session is read by a voice generated by AI from a real person's recording, used with their consent.
ready.prepare: Before you start: make sure your device is fully charged or plugged in, and wear earphones. Without earphones the session won't be effective. Find a quiet, comfortable place where you won't be disturbed.
ready.safety: Listen only when you can safely relax, never while driving or operating machinery.
preview.title: Preview your session
preview.body: The first five minutes of the session made for you. Listen with earphones, somewhere quiet.
preview.preparing: Your preview is being prepared. This takes a few minutes. You don't need to wait on this page: we'll email you a link as soon as it's ready.
preview.failed: Sorry, your preview couldn't be prepared.
preview.unavailable: The preview isn't available on this device.
download.title: Download your session
download.body: Save the full session to your device as an MP3 and listen whenever you are ready.
download.writing: Thank you. Your full session is being written for you now, which takes a few minutes. You don't need to wait on this page: we'll email you the download link as soon as it's ready.
download.preparing: Your full session is being recorded: {progress}% done. You don't need to wait on this page: we'll email you the download link as soon as it's ready.
download.keep: Your session is available here for {days} days, so please save it to your device.
audio.failed: Sorry, your session's audio could not be prepared. Please contact us and we will sort it out.
audio.expired: This audio has been removed: sessions are kept for {days} days only.
expired.title: This preview has expired
expired.body: Previews are kept for {days} days. You're welcome to start again with a new consultation.
feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.comments: Tell us how your session went, or anything you'd like us to know.
